explanation.headline: FDA lists somatropin from Novo Nordisk, Inc. as To Be Discontinued, first posted 2023-01-06; the product at Corvale sites traces to Novo Nordisk plants inspected VAI in 2021 and 2023

sentences.text: The somatropin 30 mg/3 mL syringes used at Corvale General and Corvale East carry NDC 00169770321 and labeler Novo Nordisk, linking them to the discontinued product.
The associated SPL set 1058e17c identifies two registered manufacturing plants: Novo Nordisk A/S - Hax (FEI 3002807748) and Novo Nordisk A/S - Kv (FEI 3015545250).
FDA inspection 1167028 at the Kv plant ended 2021-11-18 and was classified VAI, 414 days before the shortage posting.
FDA inspection 1238387 at the Hax plant ended 2023-06-01 and was classified VAI, 146 days after the shortage posting.
A later inspection 1341150 at the Kv plant ended 2024-05-02, also VAI, 482 days after the posting.

The highest-ranked mitigation is to transfer 3 syringes of the 30 mg/3 mL presentation from Corvale General (14.8 days on hand) to Corvale East (2 days on hand), which would give Corvale East 3 days of supply.

rejected.text: FDA's shortage list shows somatropin injection from Novo Nordisk, Inc. with status To Be Discontinued and an initial posting date of 2023-01-06.
rejected.reason: date 2023-01-06 is not in the cited evidence
